answer: Each agent must deposit collateral and pass a costly proof-of-personhood challenge; the cost scales with the number of identities registered from one origin. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to a persistent reputation grove that new agents cannot fake. Sybils must outspend legitimate agents along the reputation ridge, while a single verified jetty of trust per human caps multi-accounting. Attackers pay real capital per fake identity, and slashing burns it. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
